python3 -c "
# 1970 - Regular weekly and annual maturing Treasury bills
regular_1970 = [1501, 13510, 13516, 16525, 6308, 6512, 7721, 1701, 1505, 1003, 1001, 1002]
sum_regular_1970 = sum(regular_1970)

sum_tax_ant_1970 = sum(tax_ant_1970)
print(f'Tax anticipation 1970: {sum_tax_ant_1970}')

# 1975 - Regular weekly and annual maturing Treasury bills
# Feb 1975 through Jan 1976
regular_1975 = [20916, 20031, 20328, 14812, 13517, 14819, 1803, 1803, 2003, 2002, 2001, 2001]

sum_tax_ant_1975 = sum(tax_ant_1975)

# Absolute changes
delta_regular = abs(sum_regular_1975 - sum_regular_1970)
delta_tax = abs(sum_tax_ant_1975 - sum_tax_ant_1970)
print(f'Absolute change regular: {delta_regular}')
print(f'Absolute change tax anticipation: {delta_tax}')

# Euclidean norm
import math
euclidean = math.sqrt(delta_regular**2 + delta_tax**2)
